name: flood-fill
description: Flood fill and boundary fill algorithms for 2D grids, similar to a paint-bucket tool, returning a modified grid copy.
aiPromptContext: Use this block to fill a contiguous region of a 2D grid with a new value, such as image paint-bucket operations, cave/room detection in tilemaps, or connected-component labelling.

parameters.name: grid
parameters.description: 2D array (grid) whose cells contain comparable values.

parameters.name: startRow
parameters.description: Row index of the seed cell to begin filling from.

parameters.name: startCol
parameters.description: Column index of the seed cell to begin filling from.

parameters.name: newValue
parameters.description: The value to fill the connected region with.
